clue.text: Icy soil that could make farmer stop

indicators.note: what letters could make is something built from them in a new order, so the following words are rearranged

blocks.note: the two words supply all ten letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Frozen ground in the far north is the kind of thing that could bring a farmer's work to a halt.
explanation.definitionFit: Permafrost is ground that stays frozen all year round in polar and high mountain regions.

clue.text: Happily thorn is treated in kindness to man

indicators.note: something treated is processed or worked on, so the preceding words are worked into a new order

blocks.note: all twelve letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thorn being cheerfully tended suggests a gardener's gentle care for even prickly things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Happily' looks like an adverb on the treatment, but it is part of the letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Philanthropy literally means love of humankind, shown through generous giving and charitable work for others.

clue.text: Lots of papers about large region

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece is placed surrounding the other

blocks.note: a ream is a large quantity of paper, 500 sheets
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A huge pile of newspapers covering a large area.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom or domain, a field or area over which something extends.

clue.text: Dismiss indication of error in A & E

indicators.note: one thing sitting in another is held inside it, so the mark goes within the hospital letters

blocks.note: A & E is the British hospital accident and emergency department; its two letters form the outside
a cross is the mark a teacher puts against a wrong answer

explanation.surface: Someone gets fired over a mistake made in a hospital emergency department.
explanation.walkthrough: A & E (accident and emergency) is the British name for a hospital emergency room.
explanation.definitionFit: To axe someone is an informal way of saying to sack or fire them from their job.

clue.text: Make improvements to Republican attitude

blocks.note: Rep is a standard abbreviation for Republican
an air is a manner or bearing someone puts on

explanation.surface: A political party member is urged to adopt a better outlook.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair something is to fix or mend it, restoring a damaged object to good condition.

clue.text: Elevated American rock group into smart, dominant position

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising something up makes it read from bottom to top
putting one thing into another places it inside, so the band goes within the next word

blocks.note: US is the abbreviation for American, here read upwards
R.E.M. was an American rock band from Georgia
smart in the sense of brisk or quick, as in a smart pace

explanation.surface: A celebrated American band rises to the top of the charts, sharp and commanding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elevated American rock group' reads as one phrase, but American is reversed alone and the band sits inside a word for quick.
explanation.definitionFit: Supremacy is the state of being superior to all others in power or status.

clue.text: Trashy equipment given to school

blocks.note: kit is gear or equipment
Sch is the abbreviation for school

explanation.surface: Cheap, shoddy gear has been handed out to a school.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitsch describes art or objects in poor taste, garish or sentimental, often appreciated ironically.

clue.text: Sewing shop here has drab fancy upholstery at the rear

indicators.note: fancy as a verb-like adjective means elaborate or made up, so the letters are dressed up in another order
the rear of a word is its final letter, so only that one is kept

blocks.note: eleven letters to be rearranged
the last letter of upholstery joins the rearranged letters

explanation.surface: A sewing shop where dull fabric is fancily stitched onto furniture in the back.
explanation.walkthrough: A haberdashery is the British term for a shop selling buttons, thread and ribbons; in the US the word means a men's outfitter.
explanation.definitionFit: A haberdasher's shop sells small sewing items such as needles, thread, buttons, ribbons and zips.

clue.text: Foolish way for both life and fame to end?

definitions.text: way for both life and fame to end?

blocks.note: first meaning: silly, senseless

blocks.clueFragment: way for both life and fame to end?
blocks.note: cryptic second meaning: both words finish with the letter E, read as a three-word phrase

explanation.walkthrough: The second part looks philosophical about death and lost celebrity, but it simply observes that life and fame each end 'in an E'.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means silly or lacking sense, as in an inane remark with no real content.

clue.text: Secretary I encountered in park, unusually hot stuff!

indicators.note: something encountered in a place is found inside it, so one letter goes within the next word
unusually means not in the normal way, so the letters appear in a different order

blocks.note: PA is a personal assistant, a secretary
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An office worker reports bumping into someone in the park and finding something spicy.
explanation.definitionFit: Paprika is a red spice made from ground dried peppers, sometimes fiery in flavour.

clue.text: A haze amidst grain when fighting stops

indicators.note: amidst means in the middle of, so the haze sits inside the grain

blocks.note: taken as written
rice is a cereal grain
mist is a light haze

explanation.surface: A haze lingers over cornfields as a battle comes to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: An armistice is a truce, an agreement between warring sides to halt hostilities.

clue.text: Dried fruit and drink abandoned by a Muslim state

indicators.note: something abandoned by a companion loses it, so that letter is left out

blocks.note: a sultana is a dried grape
tea is a drink
the letter to be removed from the drink

explanation.surface: Dried fruit and a drink are left behind by someone, in an Islamic country.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultanate is a country or territory ruled by a sultan, such as Oman or Brunei.

clue.text: Observe those completing races before me

indicators.note: the letters completing a word are its final ones, so the last of each word is kept

blocks.note: the final letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A spectator is told to watch the runners who finish their races ahead of the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe and to see both mean to notice or perceive with the eyes.

clue.text: Court case regarding family putting out book

indicators.note: putting something out ejects it, so that letter is removed

blocks.note: tribal means relating to a tribe or family group
B is the abbreviation for book

explanation.surface: A legal case about a family who are publishing a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial is the hearing of evidence in a court of law to decide a case.

clue.text: Small record label curtailed attempt to produce one of the blues

indicators.note: curtailed means having its tail cut off, so the last letter is dropped

blocks.note: an indie is an independent, typically small, record label
a go is a try or attempt

explanation.surface: A modest record company scales back its effort to release a blues track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The blues' suggests music, but here it means shades of blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigo is a deep blue-violet colour, one of the bands of the rainbow.

clue.text: Dad turned round and concealed insect attacking roses

indicators.note: turning round makes the word face the other way, so it reads backwards

blocks.note: pa is an informal word for father
hid is the past tense of hide

explanation.surface: A father spun around and hid a bug that was ravaging the rose bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphids such as greenfly are small sap-sucking insects that are a common garden pest on roses.

clue.text: Keep actors in front of full theatre ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately points to what comes last, so the final letter of each word is taken

blocks.note: the cast is the set of actors in a production
the final letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Actors are kept on stage before a packed house at the end of the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keep' looks like a verb, but it is the noun: the fortified tower of a medieval fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: A keep is the strongest central tower of a fortress, so it stands for the whole stronghold.

clue.text: Study overlooking a Communist

indicators.note: overlooking something means missing it out, so that letter is omitted

blocks.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
the letter to be left out

explanation.surface: Someone studying a Marxist thinker from a lofty vantage point.
explanation.definitionFit: Red is a long-standing informal label for a socialist or Communist, from the colour of their flag.

clue.text: A foolish sheep overturned flowering plant

indicators.note: something overturned is upended, so the words are read back to front

blocks.note: taken as written
silly for foolish and ram for a male sheep

explanation.surface: A daft sheep has tumbled over in a field of flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Amaryllis is a bulb plant with large trumpet-shaped blooms, often grown indoors in winter.

clue.text: Wool producer set up a selection of shops

indicators.note: in a down clue, setting something up raises it so it reads from the bottom upwards

blocks.note: taken as written
a mall is a collection of shops under one roof

explanation.surface: A sheep farmer opens a little cluster of shops.
explanation.definitionFit: The llama is a South American animal kept for its soft fleece as well as for carrying loads.

clue.text: Send message for soldier to appear in display

blocks.note: to page someone is to send them a message by pager or announcement
a soldier ant is a kind of ant, so soldier stands for ant

explanation.surface: An order goes out summoning a soldier to take part in a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageant is a colourful public show or procession, often with costumes and historical scenes.

clue.text: Small creature like rabbit in allotment

blocks.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a hare is a long-eared animal resembling a large rabbit

explanation.surface: A tiny bunny-like animal is spotted in a vegetable plot.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment in Britain is a rented plot for growing vegetables; here it means a portion handed out.
explanation.definitionFit: A share is a portion allocated to one person from a larger whole, like an allocation.

clue.text: Do water sport? Avoid losing power

indicators.note: losing something means going without it, so that letter is dropped

blocks.note: to skip something is to miss or avoid it
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to go out on the water and dodge engine power.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is an example: one may ski on water as well as snow.
explanation.definitionFit: Water-skiing is gliding on skis behind a towing boat, so skiing can be a water sport.

clue.text: Train every working animal doctor

definitions.note: a noun; veterinary is chiefly an adjective but is also a dated noun for a vet

indicators.note: working means being operated on or kneaded, so these letters are reshaped

blocks.note: all ten letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vet is told to train every working animal on the farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A veterinary surgeon treats sick animals; veterinary also serves as a noun for such a practitioner.
